test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_numeric ( u16 Array(UInt16), u32 Array(UInt32), u64 Array(UInt64), f32 Array(Float32), f64 Array(Float64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_uint8 (arr Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE perf_array_index_simd_uint8_short (arr Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_numeric SELECT materialize(range(96)::Array(UInt16)), materialize(range(4096)::Array(UInt32)), materialize(range(192)::Array(UInt64)), materialize(arrayMap(x -> toFloat32(x), range(4096))), materialize(arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(4096))) FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_uint8 SELECT materialize(arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x % 255), range(4096))) FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO perf_array_index_simd_uint8_short SELECT materialize(range(10)::Array(UInt8)) FROM numbers(1000000)
